name: Sorrento Back Beach & Ocean Baths
signature: Sorrento's ocean side — limestone cliffs, Bass Strait swell, and the Peninsula's most iconic ocean baths carved directly from the rock
editorNote:
Sorrento Back Beach is the ocean-facing counterpart to the calm front beach — Bass Strait swell, limestone cliffs, and the ocean baths that have been carved into the rock platform at the western end since the 1930s. The baths are free, tidal, and one of the most distinctive swimming experiences on the entire Peninsula.

The beach itself is patrolled by Sorrento SLSC on weekends and public holidays through summer. The surf is real — stronger than Blairgowrie, weaker than Gunnamatta — and the limestone cliff backdrop makes it one of the most photographed surf beaches in Victoria.

The ocean baths fill with fresh Bass Strait water at high tide and are calm enough for lap swimming at most stages of the tide. Come at dawn before anyone else arrives — the light on the limestone and the empty baths is one of those Peninsula moments that visitors come back for.
whyWeGo: The ocean baths carved from limestone at the tip of the Peninsula — free, tidal, and unlike anything else.
ifOnlyOneThing: The ocean baths at dawn. Bring a towel and nothing else.
